# Tuteliq Roblox SDK

> AI-powered child safety moderation for Roblox: detects grooming, bullying, and unsafe content in real-time chat.

## What is this?
A server-side Roblox Luau module for the Tuteliq child safety API. It monitors in-game chat and detects grooming, bullying (including bullying a player reports), self-harm and distress, and other harmful content targeting young players.

## Install
Download TuteliqSafety.rbxm from the latest GitHub release and insert it into ServerScriptService, add it from the Roblox Creator Store, or build it from src/ with Rojo (rojo build default.project.json -o TuteliqSafety.rbxm).

## Quick Start
local TuteliqSafety = require(game.ServerScriptService.TuteliqSafety)
TuteliqSafety.start({
    apiKey = "tq_live_YOUR_API_KEY_HERE",
    sensitivity = "medium", -- low | medium | high | maximum
    detect = { "bullying", "grooming", "unsafe" },
    getPlayerAge = function(player) return nil end, -- optional: a player's age when known
})
TuteliqSafety.onDetection().Event:Connect(function(data) print(data.type, data.recommendedAction) end)
TuteliqSafety.analyzeNow("message to check", "unsafe", player) -- manual analysis

## Key Features
- Real-time chat moderation, every message analysed
- Detections routed on the API's recommended_action (none, monitor, flag_for_review, block, immediate_intervention)
- Mute and kick only ever apply to a player harming others; reports and distress are flagged needsSupport
- Grooming analysed per pair of players, with ages when the game provides them
- Batching and rate-limit handling that holds messages instead of dropping them
- 32 languages: en, es, pt, uk, sv, no, da, fi, de, fr, nl, pl, it, tr, ro, el, cs, hu, bg, hr, sk, lt, lv, et, sl, mt, ga, zh, ja, ko, ar, ru
